description: FastAPI application for career-path navigation backend. Implements APIs for health check, roles listing and detail, progress tracking, graph construction, recommendations, and assessments. Includes initialization code for database setup and seeding.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Data model representing a career role, including skills and relationships

classes.name: RoleSkill
classes.description: Represents skills associated with a role, including recommendation synonyms

classes.name: Recommendation
classes.description: Recommendation details linked to role skills

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes database, creates tables, and seeds minimal dataset if necessary.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all roles in the database.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific role, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches progress entries for a specific role.

methods.name: ProgressOut set_progress( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates or updates progress for a specific skill within a role.

methods.name: GraphOut get_graph( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Constructs a role transition graph for visualization.

methods.name: List[RecommendationOut] get_recommendations( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches recommendations related to a role and skill.

methods.name: AssessmentOut assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Analyzes and compares required skill levels between current and target roles to identify strengths and gaps.

ctags.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
ctags.pattern: /^    ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [o.strip() for o in _env_origins.split(",") if o.strip()]$/

ctags.name: assess_roles
ctags.pattern: /^def assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AssessmentOut:$/

ctags.name: get_graph
ctags.signature: ( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: get_recommendations
ctags.signature: ( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: get_role_detail
ctags.pattern: /^def get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> RoleDetailOut:$/

ctags.name: get_role_progress
ctags.pattern: /^def get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> List[ProgressOut]:$/

ctags.name: set_progress
ctags.signature: ( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

fields.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [o.strip() for o in _env_origins.split(",") if o.strip()]
